title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table Anime Gets Sequel
content: Kadokawa announced on Sunday that SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table , the television anime of writer Yūshi Ukai and artist Nekometal 's Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table ( Shibō Yūgi de Meshi o Kuu ) light novel series, will get a sequel work.
author: ANN

title: 20 Years Ago, Bleach’s Dub Forever Changed a Major Plot Twist & Fans Didn’t Even Notice
content: Bleach Episode 62 features some of the most crucial moments in the entire series. The episode was originally released in Japan on December 20th, 2005, before getting its English release on September 8th, 2006.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Kekkaishi no Ichirinka' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo
content: The official website of the Kekkaishi no Ichirinka ( Bride of the Barrier Master ) television anime revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and first promotional video on Sunday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Bride of the Barrier Master Anime Reveals Main Trailer, Visual, Additional Cast, Opening Theme Song Artist
content: To celebrate November 22nd’s “Good Spouses Day” in Japan, the main visual trailer for Bride of the Barrier anime have been released. The latest trailer features the opening theme song “Ichirinka” by Naniwa Danshi.
author: Anime Corner

title: Bride of the Barrier Master TV Anime Reveals 1-Hour Debut on January 6, More Cast in Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Kureha 's Bride of the Barrier Master ( Kekkaishi no Ichirinka ) light novel series revealed the anime's January 6 debut, opening theme song, more cast, new visual, and main promotional video on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: After 31 Years, This Legendary Sci-Fi Anime Movie Still Has No Worthy Competition
content: During a career spanning over forty years, Mamoru Oshii became a pioneering anime director and filmmaker, best known for his incredible work in the Ghost in the Shell franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: Classroom of the Elite Season 5 Announces 2027 Premiere Date
content: It was announced at the MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival event that Classroom of the Elite Season 5 is set to premiere in 2027. A teaser visual and trailer were also released. Season 5 was officially announced immediately after the fourth season’s finale premiered.
author: Anime Corner

title: Solo Leveling’s Biggest Competitor Is Making a Huge Comeback Ahead of Anime Premiere
content: There’s no denying that Solo Leveling is the most popular and influential webtoon and light novel series of all time. It also paved the path for the entire medium’s success across the globe, encouraging more animation studios to release webtoon adaptations.
